entities.summary: Sergei Pavlovich Roldugin is a Russian cellist and businessman based in St Petersburg. He is a close friend of Vladimir Putin. He has been implicated in several money laundering and offshore wealth schemes for Russian elites. Following the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the European Union sanctioned Roldugin. Sergei Roldugin was a performers & entertainers from Sakhalin Oblast (b. 1951-09-28, Sakhalin Oblast). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
